Overstated claims: CLAIMS for test_envelope_join.py (e.g., 'ABSORPTION F3') and test_semantic_route_live.py (FakeOllama class) cannot be verified against the provided symbol list.
Duplicate symbol entry: cancel_all_managed appears twice in daedalus/spine/cancel.py, possibly a transcription error.

Cross-validate WRITES/READS edges with other shards to confirm orphan writes.
